vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: crypto-market-data-aisa
Version: 1.0.1

The skill is a standard API client for fetching cryptocurrency market data from the AIsa API (api.aisa.one). The Python script (scripts/coingecko_client.py) uses the standard library's urllib to perform GET requests and properly sanitizes parameters using urllib.parse.quote. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection in the SKILL.md instructions; all functionality is strictly aligned with the stated purpose of crypto market research.

llm.summary: This appears to be a read-only crypto market data tool, but users should know it sends queries to AIsa using an AIsa API key and its description slightly overstates stock/dividend use.

dimensions.detail: The core purpose and code are coherent for CoinGecko-backed cryptocurrency market data. One description line also mentions stock analysis and dividend research, which is broader than the visible crypto-only endpoints.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are mainly user-directed command examples for read-only market data lookups; no destructive actions, forced tool use, or prompt-override behavior is shown.

llm.guidance: This skill looks appropriate for read-only cryptocurrency market research. Before installing, confirm you are comfortable providing an AISA_API_KEY and having crypto lookup queries sent to AIsa; do not treat it as a stock or dividend research tool unless the provider explicitly supports those datasets.

evidence.explanation: The client reads an AIsa API key from the environment and sends it as a bearer token to the AIsa API. This is expected for the service, but it is still account/credential use.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use a dedicated, least-privilege API key if available, monitor usage, and revoke or rotate the key if you uninstall or stop using the skill.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Your AIsa API key may be used for API access, quota, billing, or account attribution when the skill is invoked.

evidence.explanation: The bundled script performs external HTTP requests to AIsa using user-supplied query parameters. This is aligned with the skill's market-data purpose, but it means crypto queries leave the local environment.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Avoid sending information you consider private, such as sensitive portfolio strategy details, unless you are comfortable sharing those queries with the API provider.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Coin IDs, exchange IDs, contract addresses, and related market-data queries may be visible to the API provider.

evidence.explanation: The visible functionality is CoinGecko-backed cryptocurrency data, so mentioning stock analysis and dividend research could cause the agent to invoke the skill for unsupported financial tasks.
evidence.snippet: Use when: the user needs market data, stock analysis, dividend research, or read-only financial data workflows.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use this skill for cryptocurrency and CoinGecko-style market data; use a separate finance data source for stocks or dividends.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The tool may be selected for some non-crypto finance questions where it cannot provide appropriate data.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill makes disclosed, read-only external API calls and has a minor overbroad description for stock/dividend use, but no unsafe automation or mutation is shown.

permission_boundary.summary: It requires and transmits an AIsa API key as expected for the service.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: No persistent memory, inter-agent messaging, local private-data indexing, or wallet/private-key handling is shown in the provided artifacts.
